Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

SLAVE CIRCUITS EMPLACEMENT POINTS AVAILABILITY SIZE RESTRICTION COST
Basic 1 Common - 1000 (Base)
Advanced 1 Common - 4000 (Base)
Recall 0 Military Colossal or Smaller 6000 (Base)

Slave circuitry reduces the number of crewmembers required to operate a Starship. This Starship Accessory is most commonly present in older Capital Ships, which requires tens of thousands of crew. Basic Slave Circuits reduces the crew requirements of a Starship by 1/3, and Advanced Slave Circuits reduces it by 2/3. The crew requirement for a Starship is never reduced to less than 1- only certain exceptional and custom-built Slave Circuits are capable of such a feat, such as those guiding The Katana Fleet. The Crew Quality of a Starship that has Slave Circuits is still based on it's remaining crew.

Recall Slave Circuits

Available only for Starships equipped with Advanced Slave Circuits, Recall Slave Circuits allow a Starship to be summoned by Comlink to the owner even when no one is aboard the ship. A ship piloted by it's Recall Slave Circuits can only lift off, fly directly to the Comlink used to summon it, and land at that location- it can take no other Actions. The Crew Quality of a ship under the control of Recall Slave Circuits is Untrained (+0 check modifier), and anyone in the Pilot's position can disable the Recall Slave Circuits as a Swift Action.
